assets.routing: Worker delegates public build assets to ASSETS; native routes keep session authority

operatorAuth: Native emailed single-use magic link; cookie session checked on documents, HTTP and functions; local mail is captured in /__dev/outbox
workspace: Exactly one workspace with equal operators; no roles or tenancy
delegation: Native consent and scoped bearer APIs; handoff upsert only; no outreach approval or send authority
ownerBootstrap: node scripts/rer.mjs setup --owner-email OWNER locally; node scripts/rer.mjs deploy claims the hosted owner with a one-use setup token
